data.text:
Puran Das Beragi S/O Vishnu Das Beragi vs State Of Rajasthan 
(2024:Rj-Jp:16505) on 8 April, 2024
Author: Mahendar Kumar Goyal 
Bench: Mahendar Kumar Goyal
 [2024:Rj-Jp:16505]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
 S.B. Civil Writ Petition No. 7755/20
 1. Puran Das Beragi S/o Vishnu Das Beragi, M/s 
 Mishtan Bhanadar , Anu Shakati Colony Shoppin 
 Post Rawatbhata Chittorghar R/o Near Adarsh 
 Mandir Naya Bazar Rawatbhata Chittorghar.
 2. Hero Alamchandani S/o Daya Ram Alamchandani,
 Honey Enterprises At Hat Chock Chetak Market
 Rawat Bhata Chittorgahr
 3. Ankit Bhora S/o Chandra Prakash Bohara, M/s 
 Foods 262, Shopping Center Kota And B-16, Ga
 Krishna Nagar Ward No 33 Kota. 
 4. Virenda Porwal S/o Kailash Nath Porwal, Nomi
 Devyani Foods Industries Ltd At R-21,22,23 I
 Power House Jhotwara Industrial Area Jhotwar
 5. Indra Pratap Singh S/o Bp Singh, Nominee M/s
 Foods Industries Ltd At 107, Kimi Stone Agra 
 Highway Village Dhotana Th. Chatta Dis. Math 
 6. Devyani Foods Industries Ltd, At F-2/7, Akhl
 Area Phase 1 New Delhi
 
 Versus
 State Of Rajasthan, Through Food Safety Officer, Off
 Medical And Health Officer, Chittorghar .
 
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Vaibhav Gupta for Mr. Mayank Gupta For Respondent(s) : Mr. Bharat Saini,
Agc Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Mahendar Kumar Goyal Judgment / Order 08/04/2024 
Learned counsel for the petitioners wants to withdraw this civil writ petition. 
The civil writ petition is dismissed accordingly. Pending application(s), if any, also stands disposed of. 
(MAHENDAR KUMAR GOYAL),J Manish/270 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
